sources.vendor_fact: PATCH users/{id}; accountEnabled uses User.EnableDisableAccount.All and User.Read.All; success 204.
sources.local_design: Only accountEnabled:false, allowlisted non-admin cloud Member user; all dispatch disabled.

sources.vendor_fact: POST users/{id}/revokeSignInSessions without body, app User.RevokeSessions.All; advances cutoff, delay possible; external-user sessions excluded.
sources.local_design: Observe strictly advanced selected cutoff; attribution unknown; never claim all access stopped or blindly replay POST.

sources.vendor_fact: DELETE groups/{id}/members/{id}/$ref, app GroupMember.ReadWrite.All, 204. Missing $ref can delete object; dynamic membership cannot be removed.
sources.local_design: Require exact reference route and supported static cloud security non-role group; paginated existing-object readback required.

sources.vendor_fact: GET users/{id}, selected properties and application User.Read.All supported.
sources.local_design: Select only identity, account flag, type, sync flag and session cutoff; missing or wrong types fail closed.

sources.vendor_fact: signInSessionsValidFromDateTime is a read-only DateTimeOffset requiring selection.
sources.local_design: Require a UTC cutoff before intent; reject null/partial user metadata; compare after simulated attempt.

sources.vendor_fact: Direct memberOf can contain groups, roles and administrative units; app-only Directory.Read.All; advanced filters/casts require consistency considerations.
sources.local_design: Plain direct memberOf with select=id and top=20, typed allowlisted groups only, no cast/filter; no transitive-access claim.

sources.vendor_fact: GET groups/{id}; select supports nondefault properties; Directory.Read.All is a documented application permission.
sources.local_design: Read both allowed groups on each snapshot even when target membership is absent.

sources.vendor_fact: Group metadata includes groupTypes, security/mail flags, role assignability, membership rule and on-premises synchronization.
sources.local_design: Closed selected schema, explicit role flag false; missing/null flag denied pending real compatibility checks.

sources.vendor_fact: GET organization supports select and returns one organization object in a collection; application Directory.Read.All supported.
sources.local_design: Read only id and require configured tenant; does not prove application or consent identity.

sources.vendor_fact: Follow supplied nextLink URLs until absent, preserving opaque paging tokens.
sources.local_design: Validate full nextLink host/user/path/query; cap 3 pages, 20 rows/page, 40 persisted calls and 64 KiB/reply; unsupported pagination fails closed.

sources.vendor_fact: 429 signals throttling; Retry-After guides delayed retries.
sources.local_design: Zero automatic retries in this slice; no sleep or retry storm; future scheduled reads must honor advice and reserve budgets.

sources.vendor_fact: App-only client credentials use tenant authority and Graph .default scope with administrator-granted permissions.
sources.local_design: Future main-owned token-loader protocol only, never invoked; real secure loader and consent verification pending.

sources.vendor_fact: Clients treat access tokens as opaque; resource APIs validate them. Graph tokens cannot be validated using generic client claim assumptions.
sources.local_design: No JWT decoding as proof; trusted account/application/tenant attestation is explicit input, with real validation pending.

evidence_limit: Documentation review and authored contract choices only; no real endpoint/auth/account observation. No downloaded SDK or new dependency.
